title: Second regression: Michael lying opposite with small being between them
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: whereas in regression number two I found out that Michael was laying opposite to me and there was one of the short ones or small ones between us

plain: In 1977 in South Dakota, aboard a craft, Mario Woods lay across from his fellow guard Michael Johnson with one of the small beings standing between them. Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who says he was abducted, tells Michels he only learned this in his second hypnotic regression, a session using hypnosis to recover memories, which he names Yvonne Smith in connection with. "In regression number two I found out that Michael was laying opposite to me and there was one of the short ones or small ones between us," he says. That would mean the two men were taken together.
